### New in 1.5.4
- **Pet Surface Constraints & Transitions**: Pets now walk, jump, stand, and sit strictly on clear surfaces above blocks. On To-do cards, pets stand directly on top of the card ledge (never inside or covering text). When switching screens, perched pets jump gracefully down to the floor and walk across through to the next page. On Settings, Stats, and Library pages, pets strictly remain on the clear floor surface and never hover over letters, words, or tiles.
- **Sample Library Logout & Clean Actual Library**: When starting with the sample library, a dedicated "Sample Library" banner on Home provides a quick "Logout" button to return to the welcome screen. Starting fresh without sample library now opens an actual clean library with an empty to-do list (no dummy to-do items).
- **Delete User Account Option**: Added a prominent "Delete user" button in the Profile page that completely wipes all books, shelves, reading progress, to-do lists, and user profile data, returning to the clean welcome screen.
- **Upward Drag-to-Share on Home**: Dragging a book upwards from the Home shelf lifts it into the air and displays Send and Receive drop zones. Dropping the book into "Send" initiates peer-to-peer transfer to nearby or paired users.
- **Peer-to-Peer Book Sharing & 4-Digit Pairing Code**: Users can connect temporarily or permanently via a 4-digit code or choose friends from their paired list. User 2 accepts the book to add it directly to their library under a dedicated "Shared books" shelf.
- **Shared Shelf Attribution**: Opening any book from the "Shared books" shelf displays attribution showing "Book from [username]", with full reading, bookmarking, updating, and editing capabilities.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
